Reviving a newsletter

Dec 3, 2025

Short update: I discovered a very old (2021) newsletter that I'm going to revive in the hopes of communicating more directly with people about my music.

It is not a Substack. It's a good old fashioned newsletter powered by Buttondown.

You can sign up to receive (occasional, maybe once a month if that) emails about my musical explorations, upcoming releases, tour dates, etc.
